title: Seats
description: Move the driver and passenger seats from the central display, also while driving, both on one page: each seat seen from the side with its controls round it (fore / aft, height, backrest, tilt and headrest, while you hold them), three memories per seat under it, and the Gentleman button (parked only) that moves the passenger seat out of the way and back. Needs the Comfort tool from the same source. iDrive 7 and 8.
